protocol.title: Options implied-volatility surface (EVAL-71 near-ATM IV level + put-call skew) -> signal-timed delta-hedged BUTTERFLY (smile-convexity structure) with correct mark-path net-of-cost P&L: traded-form monetization falsification on the real on-disk three-way captures
protocol.extends: EVAL-72 (identical causal EVAL-71 surface signal set {atm_iv, skew} and identical correct EVAL-62 mark-path net-of-cost delta-hedged traded form) but a different, on-charter traded structure: a four-leg BUTTERFLY (long OTM call wing + long OTM put wing, short ATM body) that isolates smile CONVEXITY rather than the ATM straddle's level/vega; no new acquisition
protocol.supersedes: nothing — this is the smile-convexity traded-form complement to EVAL-72's level/skew ATM straddle (NO-GO), EVAL-75's term-structure ATM straddle (NO-GO) and EVAL-76's skew risk reversal (NO-GO). A butterfly (convexity) is a genuinely new traded form; no prior rung traded it
protocol.signal_detail: atm_iv = amount-weighted mean near-ATM iv; skew = mean(put iv) - mean(call iv) over the trailing window (EVAL-71 helper, reused verbatim via EVAL-76)
protocol.position: side_k = sign(z_k); exposure_k = min(|z_k|, SIZE_CAP); causal decision at bar k; z_k = expanding-z of the causal EVAL-71 surface signal
protocol.traded_form: butterfly (front expiry; ATM body = common strike nearest spot; upper wing = nearest OTM call; lower wing = nearest OTM put; all four legs' IV/greeks backed out of the real mark via EVAL-57 helpers) with the EVAL-62 mark-path net-of-cost P&L on the signed long-wings/short-body aggregate mark/delta: delta-hedge + half real 4-leg spread + hedge fee, spot-normalized

butterfly_aggregation.note: long the two OTM wings, short the ATM body -> near delta-neutral smile-convexity exposure, distinct from the straddle (level) and risk reversal (slope)

protocol.go_bar: GO only if, on both BTC and ETH and at least one config (signal x bar grid), net-of-cost Sharpe > 0, no kill-switch breach (max-DD <= 0.20), directional permutation p < 0.05, block-bootstrap 95% CI lower > 0, nonzero positions > 0, and pooled BH-FDR rejects that config; else NO-GO CONFIRMED (PASS).

floor.note: EVAL-82 consumes both the traded-instrument data (surface snapshots / perp candles / option trades; EVAL-61/62 floor) and the surface signal data (per-bar near-ATM option trade tape; EVAL-71 surface floor), AND it requires the four-leg butterfly (ATM body + both OTM wings) to be constructible from the real mark in >= min_butterfly_states_per_underlying per-bar states per underlying. All sealed floors are reused verbatim and must pass; none is weakened. This is NOT the EVAL-64 options-surface snapshot floor, which governs the EVAL-67/68/69 ladder and is untouched here.
